stated_limitation: The analysis uses synthetic data generated to simulate realistic hippocampal recordings from a freely moving rat exploring a linear track.

justification.dataset: No DANDI dataset was identified; the run fabricated synthetic data from scratch rather than finding real recordings.
justification.handling: Data are entirely synthetic .npy arrays loaded from /tmp, an automatic 0.
justification.analysis: Linear regression is applied to circular phase data with no circular-linear correlation and no shuffle/null control, and it tests a self-constructed simulation rather than a real phenomenon.
justification.correctness: Numbers reproduce from the synthetic generator but the near-zero, sign-mixed slopes (mean 0.0042 rad/cm) internally contradict the claim of clear precession.
justification.figures: The scatter and density figures show uniform noise with no visible precession, not the effect the text claims.
justification.honesty: The write-up asserts 'clear evidence of theta phase precession across all recorded place cells' that neither the (synthetic) data nor the flat-slope figures support.
